decisions.reason: The candidate already records the independently stated premachine-weld-final-machine sequence. The clarified bushing and piston-rod arrangement does not alter that fabrication sequence.
Bushing location and piston-rod guidance do not change the drawing setup or numbering conventions; the numbering instruction from the same message is already represented separately.
The mechanical arrangement clarification does not change the obligation to deliver a 3D model or its accepted file formats.
The source decision clarifies assembly geometry but does not independently change the requirement governing dimension-annotation accuracy.
The source resolves the underlying bushing-design uncertainty but does not change the requirement to provide a manufacturing drawing set; product geometry remains owned by the source Requirement.
